about: MS Contin (morphine, a regular opioid) is supplied monthly from May to October 2026 by brand name only, and no laxative is supplied.
Scheduled Targin supplies in January, February and March have no regular laxative cover. Picoprep was supplied for colonoscopy, and the last Targin pack finishes months before the final record date.
Endone was supplied only as needed. The separate scheduled course of tramadol has overlapping nightly Dulcolax SP Drops.
